rules.title: Personal data reaches a log call
rules.shortDescription: A source reaches a log sink
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data is passed to a logging call. Logs are copied to collectors, dashboards and backups, usually with weaker access control and no retention limit than the primary store.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Remove the value from the log call, log a surrogate identifier instead, or mask it before logging. Check who can read the logs and for how long they are kept.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Personal data is sent to a third-party host
rules.shortDescription: A source reaches an http sink with a literal host or a non-literal URL
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data is sent in an HTTP request to a host outside the application, or to a URL the scan could not resolve. Art. 28 applies if the vendor acts as a processor; verify the vendor's role, because some vendors are independent controllers.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Confirm who operates the destination, what contract covers it and whether the data is needed. Relative first-party URLs are not reported.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.
rules.severity: matrix; note when the host is unresolved

rules.title: Personal data reaches an analytics SDK
rules.shortDescription: A source reaches an analytics sink
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data is passed to an analytics or monitoring SDK. Art. 28 applies if the vendor acts as a processor; verify the vendor's role, because an analytics vendor may be an independent controller.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Send pseudonymous identifiers instead of direct identifiers, confirm the purpose and legal basis, and check the vendor's data processing terms and hosting region.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Personal data is written to a file
rules.shortDescription: A source reaches a file sink
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data is written to a file by the application. Files on local disks often escape the access control, encryption and retention rules of the main database.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Check where the file lives, who can read it, whether it is encrypted and when it is deleted. Prefer the primary data store.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Personal data is placed in a URL query string
rules.shortDescription: A source is interpolated into a URL query string
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data is written into the query string of a URL. Query strings end up in server logs, browser history, proxies and referrer headers.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Send the value in the request body or a header over TLS, or use an opaque token. Remove the value from URLs that are logged or shared.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.
rules.severity: matrix; error for identifiers and sensitive data

rules.title: Personal data may be transferred internationally
rules.shortDescription: A source reaches a known vendor whose transfer status needs a mechanism or is conditional
rules.fullDescription: A value classified as personal data reaches a vendor that is outside the selected regime's domestic and adequate destinations, so an international transfer mechanism is needed or must be verified. Adequacy status is dated data and goes stale.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Identify the transfer mechanism (adequacy, certification, standard clauses, binding rules or consent), record it under vendors in the project config and verify the contract.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.
rules.severity: warning; error when a sensitive category reaches that sink

rules.title: Sensitive field stored without protection
rules.shortDescription: A storage field classified as sensitive has no hash, encryption or row-level protection hint
rules.fullDescription: A table or model field classified as sensitive personal data is a plain text-like column with no sign of hashing, encryption or row-level security.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Consider column-level encryption, a separate protected table, row-level security or tokenisation. A name suffix, a comment or an attribute that marks the field as protected clears this finding.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Storage entity has no retention signal
rules.shortDescription: A storage entity with personal fields has no retention signal
rules.fullDescription: A table or model with personal data fields shows no retention mechanism: no deletion or expiry timestamp, no purge field and no retention period declared in the project config.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Define how long the data is needed, add an expiry or deletion mechanism, and declare the period under retention in the project config.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.
rules.severity: warning when the entity has a sensitive field, else note

rules.title: Possible children's data indicator
rules.shortDescription: A storage entity has a children indicator
rules.fullDescription: A table or model has fields that suggest it may hold data about children or adolescents, such as a guardian, a school or a minor flag. The tool never asserts that a data subject is a minor.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Confirm whether minors are in scope, which legal basis applies, and whether parental consent and age checks are in place.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Personal data value hard-coded in a file
rules.shortDescription: A file holds a checksum-valid personal value or an e-mail address
rules.fullDescription: A scanned file contains a literal that passes an identifier checksum, or an e-mail address. Real values in source control are copied to every clone, fork and backup.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Move the value to a secret store or replace it with synthetic test data. Rotate or delete the value if it is real.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: Ambiguous field labeled as personal data by the LLM
rules.shortDescription: The LLM labeled an ambiguous field with a personal category
rules.fullDescription: A field with a generic name was labeled by the language model as a personal data category. The label is advisory: it never changes a deterministic finding, a severity or an article.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Review the field and decide whether it holds personal data. Treat the label as a prompt for human review, not as a result.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.

rules.title: A file could not be fully parsed
rules.shortDescription: A file produced a parse, depth or dialect warning
rules.fullDescription: A file could not be parsed completely, so part of it was not scanned. The scan continued with the other files.
rules.helpMarkdown:
Fix the syntax error or exclude the file with the ignore list. Unsupported SQL dialects need a PostgreSQL export of the schema.

This is not legal advice and not a complete assessment.
